notes: Logo is a vector reconstruction (potrace, 1 colour, #000000) of the business's own header wordmark PNG (1786x484, black on transparent); no genuine SVG exists. Traced from a 3x Lanczos upscale so the hairline script 'Fig' keeps its original stroke weight; render-back mean abs diff 1.64 vs original.

Showreel: six clips, all from video files on the business's own Shopify CDN embedded on grapeandfig.com: two shots from the 1080p Virtual Masterclasses promo (finished board held up; hands folding charcuterie) and four muted product loops (Seasonal Fruit, British Cheese & Charcuterie, Crudites & Hummus, Number graze). Audio stripped; no talking-head shots used.
The product loops are portrait 810x1080, so their desktop 16:9 crops are upscaled about 1.6x and slightly softer than the landscape masterclass shots.
The Number graze clip shows the business's own GRAPE & Fig logo printed on its packaging (not an overlay).

Gallery photo-07 shows a display made for client Skin + Me with the client's product boxes visible. Other client-branded photos were left out: Beauty Pie (client branding prominent), M&S Food (burned-in #ss24mands hashtag), and the green 'Live to Eat' book-launch table (guest name card legible).
The two women in photo-08 and photo-09 are identified on the business's own site as founders Toria and Catherine; alt text describes only what is visible.

Oct 27 photo upgrade: card and gallery re-selected from original-resolution uploads on the business's own site and its own uploads on the old Booked Events site; AI renders, other businesses' images, private names and celebrity/watermarked shots excluded.
